# 00000000516

**CA-16 ★** — source: 21_交换代数与同调代数.md

**English.** Definition: Boij–Söderberg theory for modules (with rank). Conjecture: The rank part of the cone is generated by the vector-bundle Betti tables from Bott's formula (generators in the curve case).

**中文。** 定义：模的 Boij–Söderberg(带 rank)。猜想：rank 部分的锥由 Bott 公式的向量丛 Betti 表生成(曲线情形的生成性)。
